falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a shallow correction with 4,800 as structural support; a break below invalidates the bottoming thesis and suggests a deeper drawdown than the August 2024 analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility/early-stage panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates genuine systemic stress and capitulation, not the orderly bottom formation the pattern predicts

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by 0.50% or more)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current signal assumes a soft-landing/growth-scare dynamic; severe inversion would confirm recession pricing that overrides the August 2024 bottom pattern, which occurred under relatively benign credit conditions

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
